name: cloudradial-ucp
description: Connect Codex to a CloudRadial UCP Portal through a local MCP server and CloudRadial-specific skills.

interface.shortDescription: Use CloudRadial portal data and actions in Codex.
interface.longDescription: CloudRadial UCP adds a local MCP server and task-specific skills for setup, portal setup and lookup, companies, users, content, service catalog, courses, assessments and compliance exports, endpoints and refresh cards, services and domains, client deliverables, feedback, and reporting.
